title: Derived dualizability of lisse flat sheaves
statement: Let V be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and C a finite commutative ring. Let L be a finite locally constant sheaf [def-constructible-locally-constant] of C-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with flat geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Then L placed in degree zero is dualizable for the derived tensor product [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] in the ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Here dualizable means that there is a right dual D with coevaluation from the tensor unit to L tensor D and evaluation from D tensor L to the unit, satisfying both triangle identities.

source.place: Section 6.4, Example 6.4.1 and Lemma 6.4.6, printed pp. 48–49; finite locally constant flat modules are locally finite projective, so their degree-zero complexes have duals.

proof.text: Use flat_iff_forall_flat_sheafFiber_obj and the canonical ulift stalk isomorphism to obtain flatness of L. The proved source-library exactPairingIhomUnitOfIsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf supplies the internal dual of L. It is established by trivializing the sheaf, using finite presentation and flatness to obtain finite projective modules, and testing the internal-Hom comparison on geometric stalks.

The source-library theorem DerivedCategory.isDualizable_Q_obj carries the duality of a bounded complex with dualizable terms to its localization. Apply it to the single complex at L in degree zero: the term at zero is canonically isomorphic to L, and all other terms are zero and hence dualizable. Transport along DerivedCategory.singleFunctorIsoCompQ.

theorem isDualizable_singleFunctor_lisseFlat
    {C : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing C] [Finite C]
    {V : Scheme.{u}} (L : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C))
    [Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf L]
    (hL : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
      (s : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ V),
      ObjectProperty.flat ((Scheme.pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj L)) :
    IsDualizable ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C)) 0).obj L)
